title: oritrophium peruvianum subsp. lineatum
intro: Oritrophium peruvianum subsp. lineatum, commonly known as Mountain Gold or Mountain Helichrysum, is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Oritrophium peruvianum subsp. lineatum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic compounds, and triterpenoids. The sesquiterpene lactones present in this plant are responsible for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable resource for the development of new medicines.
